newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-WEEKEND PROGRAMME IN GERMAN FIRST DIVISION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WEEKEND PROGRAMME IN GERMAN FIRST DIVISION.

text.p: German first division programme this weekend:

Borussia Moenchengladbach (12) v St Pauli (13). Moechengladbach have problems in attack with Swedish striker Martin Dahlin out with calf muscle injury. St Pauli need to bounce back after shock defeat in German Cup quarter-finals by regional league side Energie Cottbus.

Bremen lost 3-1 to Bayern Munich in German Cup on Tuesday and need a good result to keep up championship challenge. Away team missing Austrian international midfielder Andreas Herzog who has concussion.

Borussia Dortmund (4) v Karlsruhe (8). Dortmund's international libero Matthias Sammer had to postpone return from long injury layoff but striker Karlheinz Riedle should be back in squad after 11-week absence.

Hamburg on a high after reaching German Cup semifinals on Wednesday but Leverkusen have excellent away record. Bayer missing suspended libero Jens Nowotny who expected to be replaced by Carsten Ramelow.

Stuttgart also celebrating place in German Cup semifinals. VfB defender Thorsten Legat missing because of shoulder injury and Swiss Sebastien Fournier to replace him. Bochum were unlucky to lose to Hamburg in German Cup after excellent second-half performance.

Bayern still without Euro 96 midfielder Mehmet Scholl (ankle injury) but key defender Thomas Helmer and wing-back Christian Ziege both fit. Freiburg desperately need points but need to lift themselves mentally after midweek German Cup defeat by Stuttgart on penalties.
Away team boosted by return of German international striker Stefan Kuntz after suspension. With just two victories to their name Arminia need all the help they can get.

Fortuna Duesseldorf (11) v Schalke (14). Middle-of-table clash which difficult to predict. Last Fortuna home win over Schalke was in 1982-83 season. Duesseldorf have very poor home record this season.
Duisburg have not won for four games but away record is solid. Away team without midfielder Dietmar Hirsch (suspended).
